records.source_title: Our Company in figures – an overview (Eberspächer facts and figures)
records.excerpt: With around 10,400 employees at 80 locations worldwide, the Eberspächer Group ranks as a leading system developer and supplier in the automotive industry. The family-owned company based in Esslingen am Neckar in Germany stands for innovative solutions in exhaust technology, automotive controls, and thermal management for a broad range of vehicle types.
records.population: Eberspächer Group
records.does_not_establish: It does not say how revenue splits between divisions or how much comes from aftermarket or private buyers.

records.source_title: Eberspaecher holds its ground in a challenging market (press release)
records.excerpt: The consolidated revenue of the Eberspaecher Group of Companies fell by 6.6% to 4,979.8m euros (previous year: 5,333.2m euros). All Divisions recorded falling revenues in an overall difficult economic environment, especially due to exchange rate effects.
records.population: Eberspächer Group, all divisions
records.does_not_establish: Group revenue does not show the size or trend of the heater business, or of aftermarket and retrofit sales within it.

records.source_title: Eberspaecher holds its ground in a challenging market (press release)
records.excerpt: The current year continues to be characterized by uncertainties and their effects on worldwide market developments. At the same time, competitive pressure is increasing, especially from Asia.
records.population: Eberspächer Group
records.does_not_establish: It does not say which products or customer groups face the Asian competition, or whether it reaches consumer heater sales.

records.source_title: OEM heating solutions for passenger cars and trucks (Eberspächer)
records.excerpt: Whether they’re powered by gasoline, Diesel, (bio) ethanol, or e-fuels, our air and water heaters are customized to meet the OEM’s requirements.
records.population: Vehicle manufacturers (OEMs) buying heaters for passenger cars and trucks
records.does_not_establish: It does not show what share of heater sales goes to OEMs rather than to dealers and retrofit buyers.

records.source_title: Dealer Search (Eberspächer Climate Control Systems)
records.excerpt: Whether for your car, truck, motor home or special vehicles - our dealers are available worldwide to assist you with sales or support inquiries.
records.population: Private and commercial vehicle owners looking for a heater dealer
records.does_not_establish: It does not say how many dealers there are, whether they are independent, or whether Eberspächer sells directly to end users.

records.source_title: Thermal management for commercial vehicles and special vehicles (Eberspächer)
records.excerpt: As initial installation or as retrofit: with our diesel and petrol auxiliary heaters you have the perfect fit between maximum independence and ultimate comfort. Save space and weight by heating your vehicle with fuel from the tank.
records.population: Recreational vehicle owners and builders
records.does_not_establish: It does not quantify retrofit sales to RV owners or say how they are reached.

records.source_title: Boats – applications (Eberspächer Climate Control Systems)
records.excerpt: Our boat heaters provide superior comfort, whether on a sailboat or a yacht. By preventing condensation from forming, they keep your cabin and your clothing dry.
records.population: Sailboat and yacht owners
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many boat heaters are sold, through which channels, or to private owners versus boatbuilders.

records.source_title: Eberspächer – providing winter comfort in cars for decades
records.excerpt: Clammy fingers in the morning are a thing of the past. With an Eberspächer pre-heater, you can look forward to getting into a pleasantly warm car with fully de-iced windows.
records.population: Private car drivers considering a retrofit pre-heater
records.does_not_establish: Consumer-facing marketing copy does not show how many private buyers it reaches or converts.

records.source_title: Caravan Salon 2024: Travel comfortably in any weather (press release)
records.excerpt: At the Caravan Salon in Duesseldorf, Germany, the thermal management expert will be showcasing products for electric and conventional drives. Visitors will find the E-Airtronic EHV1 230V/ 110V and more at the Booth B11 in Hall 13.
records.population: Caravan Salon visitors and RV manufacturers
records.does_not_establish: Exhibiting at a public fair does not show sales to individual buyers or demand for any specific product.

records.source_title: A tour of the booth (Eberspächer newsroom)
records.excerpt: "Of course, a lot of people approach us about the established auxiliary heaters," says Leonhard Bazlen. "People simply know the Airtronic and Hydronic, many have them installed in their own camper or car."
records.population: Visitors to the Eberspächer booth, including camper and car owners
records.does_not_establish: An employee's impression from a fair is not a measure of brand awareness or installed base among owners.

records.source_title: Weniger Umsatz, Werke dicht: Eberspächer spürt Krise (AUTOHAUS)
records.excerpt: Als Reaktion auf die maue Konjunktur hatte das Familienunternehmen in Deutschland die Kosten gesenkt. So wurde im thüringischen Hermsdorf die Produktion aufgegeben und im rheinland-pfälzischen Standort Herxheim die Fertigung stillgelegt.
records.population: Eberspächer's German production sites
records.does_not_establish: It does not say what was made at each site or whether heater supply for retrofit buyers is affected.

records.source_title: Antitrust: Commission fines parking heaters producer €68 million in cartel settlement (European Commission IP/15/5214)
records.excerpt: Webasto and Eberspächer are the only suppliers of fuel-operated parking heaters and fuel-operated auxiliary heaters for cars and trucks in the EEA.
records.population: Suppliers of fuel-operated parking and auxiliary heaters for cars and trucks
records.does_not_establish: The 2015 finding predates the arrival of low-cost Asian and Latvian heaters and says nothing about today's market shares.

records.source_title: Über 94.000 Neuzulassungen: Deutsche Caravaning-Industrie zieht positive Jahresbilanz (CIVD press release)
records.excerpt: Während die gewerblichen Reisemobil-Neuzulassungen mit 25.385 Einheiten um 9,7 Prozent zurückgingen, stieg die Zahl der privaten Neuzulassungen auf 49.983 Fahrzeuge (+7,2 Prozent).
records.population: Buyers of new motorhomes in 2025
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many of these vehicles lack a heater or whose owners would retrofit one.

records.source_title: Über 94.000 Neuzulassungen: Deutsche Caravaning-Industrie zieht positive Jahresbilanz (CIVD press release)
records.excerpt: Im Jahr 2025 wurden mit insgesamt 192.239 Besitzumschreibungen ein Plus von rund 2,7 Prozent und damit ein neuer Rekordwert erreicht.
records.population: Buyers of used motorhomes and caravans in 2025
records.does_not_establish: Ownership changes do not show how many used vehicles get a heater retrofitted or upgraded.

records.source_title: Eberspächer Standheizung Wohnmobil (Reimo Shop)
records.excerpt: Eine Eberspächer Standheizung zum Nachrüsten, ist in den meisten Wohnmobilen und Campingbussen kein Problem.
records.population: Camper and motorhome owners shopping at a camping accessories retailer
records.does_not_establish: A retailer's listing shows availability through a third-party channel, not sales volumes or Eberspächer's margins there.

records.source_title: Should you buy a cheap diesel heater for your RV? (RV Daily)
records.excerpt: The Erberspacher Airtronic AS3 D2L, which has a rated heat output of 2200 watts, sells for around $2460. On the other hand, the price of a 4000-watt heater from the lesser-known brand Belief is around $1310.
records.population: RV owners comparing branded and low-cost diesel heaters
records.does_not_establish: Two Australian list prices do not establish typical price gaps in Europe or how buyers trade price against safety.

records.source_title: Should you buy a cheap diesel heater for your RV? (RV Daily)
records.excerpt: Caravan and motorhome owners are tempted to purchase these units because of the huge price difference between them and the name brand equivalents. The problem is the cheap heaters are often inferior in many ways.
records.population: Caravan and motorhome owners seen by a repair workshop
records.does_not_establish: One repairer's account does not measure how many owners choose cheap heaters or how often they fail.

records.source_title: Chinese Diesel 12V heaters { Similar to eberspacher / Webasto } (MotorhomeFun forum)
records.excerpt: FULL KIT = circa £114 off ebay. 5KW of heat. Bench tested first.
records.population: A motorhome owner who fitted a low-cost heater to a van conversion
records.does_not_establish: A single forum post from 2019 does not show how widespread self-installed low-cost heaters are today.

records.source_title: Surveyors beware some diesel heater installations (International Institute of Marine Surveying)
records.excerpt: It seems from different sources that these have become very popular due to the cost, some costing as little as £98.00. They are being fitted by owners of boats, many of whom will not be aware of the strict requirements for correct installation.
records.population: Boat owners fitting unbranded diesel heater kits themselves
records.does_not_establish: It does not quantify how many boat owners buy such kits or what they would pay for a branded alternative.

records.source_title: Product Safety Report: Vevor Diesel Heater (2511-0312), Office for Product Safety and Standards
records.excerpt: The product presents a serious risk of suffocation as it is not supplied with appropriate safety information or instructions for use. Diesel heaters must only be used in sufficiently ventilated spaces, without which the user is exposed to potentially fatal concentrations of carbon monoxide.
records.population: A portable diesel heater imported from China
records.does_not_establish: One rejected import does not show that all low-cost heaters are unsafe or that buyers would pay more for a certified one.

records.source_title: Heaters and air conditioning systems for RVs & much more (Truma)
records.excerpt: With the Truma Coolers you always have your mobile refrigerator with you.
records.population: Caravan and motorhome owners buying Truma comfort products
records.does_not_establish: That a competitor sells a portable product does not show the product is profitable or that Eberspächer could do the same.

records.source_title: Heating solutions for recreational vehicles (Webasto)
records.excerpt: Another big advantage: fewer gas bottles or tanks on board mean more space and less weight for other important items. One of our installation partners in your area will be happy to advise you on retrofitting.
records.population: Owners of motorhomes, caravans and camper vans considering a retrofit heater
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many retrofit buyers Webasto reaches through its partners or on what terms.
